dod_manifest.outcome: A customer-configurable Fire TV companion, built for the Amazon Developer Hackathon Fire TV track and the AWS Builder mini challenge (SD-008), that notices NFL moments relevant to the viewer's fantasy starters, alerts the viewer while another viewing app plays, helps the viewer reach the game in a provider app the viewer already uses, and shows a right-side lineup panel beside unobscured video. It retains experience items 1, 2, 3, 4 and 6 of issue #1 plus the right-side panel, and excludes every messaging and community feature. It runs on the owner's 2018 Fire TV stick on Fire OS from the `AmazonAppDev/hello-world-fire-tv` starter (SD-001, SD-003), reads live NFL data from ESPN's unofficial public JSON (SD-004), reads lineups from Yahoo or, from T_yahoo without approval, from labeled manual entry (SD-007), and runs its backend on an owner-created AWS Free-plan account (SD-005). The panel route is decided by a spike bounded by spike_panel_max; on failure the panel runs beside the app's own player with labeled open-licensed footage (Mode A, SD-006, SD-006a).
scope: Retained experience items 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 of issue #1 plus the right-side lineup panel on the owner's Fire TV stick

requirements.statement: When the customer starts Yahoo linking on the TV app, the TV app shall display a device code and a link URL, and the backend shall bind the Yahoo authorization the customer completes in a phone browser to that device if it completes within device_code_ttl, and shall store the Yahoo OAuth tokens only in the backend.

When a linked Yahoo account exists, the backend shall list the customer's NFL leagues and teams, and the TV app shall let the customer select teams, individual players and favorite NFL teams; the backend shall classify each roster player as starter, bench or unknown from the roster's selected position for the current NFL week.

The TV app shall detect which allow-listed packages are installed using the Android package manager, shall show each detected provider app's subscription status as "Unknown" until the customer confirms it, and shall let the customer override the detected apps, each subscription status, and the local market.
If Yahoo access is not approved at T_yahoo, then the system shall offer manual lineup entry from ESPN team rosters and shall label that lineup "Manual lineup" on every screen and panel that shows it.

While a game involving a followed player is in progress and at least one following customer is in an enabled viewing period, the backend shall fetch that game's ESPN summary once every feed_poll_interval, and shall fetch no game that no such customer follows.
The backend shall fetch each in-progress game at most once per feed_poll_interval regardless of how many customers follow it.

The TV app shall read no current-playback context unless the customer has enabled detection; if the device exposes no supported current-playback interface (SP-2 verdict), then the detection setting shall read "Not available on this device"; every alert and panel state not derived from observed playback shall be labeled "Based on your profile".
While the device is outside every enabled viewing period, the TV app shall send no alert long-poll requests.

The backend shall emit GameEvents for ESPN plays and game-state changes that meet the event definitions in DES-AFC-FEED, and for corrections required by AC-AFC-FEED-02, using CONTRACT-AFC-EVENT with source game id, source play id, event type, involved ESPN athlete ids, possession team, field position, period, game clock, source timestamp and ingest timestamp; it shall emit no GameEvent for a play that meets none of those definitions and shall reject a schema-invalid response without changing stored GameEvents.

The backend shall emit at most one original GameEvent per source game id and source play id; when the recorded scoring content for that play changes, it shall emit one correction GameEvent for that change referencing the original event, and repeated retrieval of unchanged scoring content shall emit no additional event.

If one game's ESPN fetch fails or returns a schema-invalid response feed_fail_limit times in a row, then the backend shall mark that game's data stale; when the operator enables replay, the backend shall serve GameEvents from recorded fixtures and every alert and panel value derived from them shall carry the label "Replay — recorded game data".

When a GameEvent of a customer-enabled alert type is a scoring play credited to a followed player, a red_zone_entry by a followed player's team, or a close_game state of a followed player's game, the backend shall create one alert for that customer naming the player or team, the matchup, the event and the source timestamp; a red-zone alert shall state the team's field position only and shall not state that the player is on the field.

The backend shall create at most one alert per customer per source event, shall hold each alert for the customer's spoiler_delay before release, shall release no alert during the customer's quiet hours, and shall release at most one alert per game per alert_min_gap for that customer.

When a correction GameEvent changes an event that produced a released alert, the backend shall release one correction alert to that customer and shall apply the correction to that customer's panel totals.

While a provider app plays video in the foreground and the customer is in an enabled viewing period with heads-up presentation selected, the TV app shall retrieve and present each released alert as a heads-up notification with Watch and Dismiss actions without bringing the companion app to the foreground; while panel-only presentation is selected, it shall suppress heads-up notifications.

The backend shall select alert text through a documented mapping from each customer-selectable excitement level to a fixed template, substituting only GameEvent fields and matched player data; no generative model shall determine an event, score or player identity.

When the backend creates an alert, it shall attach a launch target selected from the game's ESPN broadcasts, the customer's provider apps and their subscription status, the local market and the provider preference, as exactly one of: content target with provider content id, provider details target, app home target, app absent, or access unknown; it shall attach no content target for a provider whose subscription status is "Unknown" without labeling access as unknown.

When the customer selects Watch, the TV app shall, after the confirmation the customer's switching-confirmation setting requires, launch the attached target by an explicit intent to an allow-listed package and record one launch outcome; for the provider chosen in SP-3, the outcome GAME_OPENED shall be shown on the device for one live or scheduled NFL game.
If the target package is not installed or the launch intent fails, then the TV app shall show the launch outcome and its reason, and shall show no success state.

The TV app shall let the customer set with the remote: followed teams and players, alert types, alert_min_gap, quiet hours, monitoring schedule, spoiler_delay, notification presentation (heads-up or panel only), excitement level, provider preference, switching confirmation and detection opt-in; the backend shall apply each saved setting to the next alert decision for that customer.
The TV app shall keep every saved setting across an app restart and a device reboot.
The TV app shall show the voice-announcement setting only if voice announcements are implemented and verified on the device (C8).

The lineup panel shall show the selected team’s starters, each player’s fantasy points and game status, and the team total using the league’s Yahoo scoring rules or, for a manual lineup, a documented default scoring table that specifies each counted statistic and its point coefficient; it shall label manual scoring “Default scoring,” mark each value older than stale_after “Stale,” and mark each unavailable value “Unavailable.”
While the panel is shown with video, the video shall occupy the area left of the panel with its aspect ratio preserved, and no pixel of the video frame shall be covered or cropped.

The TV app shall let the customer show and hide the lineup panel and select the followed team and league using only the remote’s D-pad, select and back keys, with a visible focus indicator on every focusable element.

When a starter change or scoring correction reaches the backend, the backend shall include it in subsequent panel responses, and the visible panel shall request those responses every panel_refresh and apply each received response; after being hidden, the panel shall request updated state when shown, and any panel value and released alert referring to the same event shall use the same corrected source facts, irrespective of whether other events produced alerts.

The SP-4 spike shall record a Mode B verdict naming the verified route, or a Mode A verdict, within spike_panel_max; in Mode A the companion player shall play only CC-BY or CC0 footage showing the label "Sample footage — not a live broadcast" on screen, and the README shall credit that footage.

requirements.statement: The APK and every tracked file shall contain no Yahoo client secret, OAuth token, AWS credential or device token; the backend shall read the Yahoo client secret from SSM Parameter Store SecureString and shall keep Yahoo OAuth tokens exclusively in backend storage, without returning them to the TV app.

The backend shall require a valid device bearer token on every API route except link start, link status, link verify and the OAuth callback, and shall answer a request with a missing or invalid token with HTTP 401 and no change to stored state.

The backend template shall declare only resource types on the template allow list (Lambda, API Gateway HTTP API, DynamoDB on-demand, EventBridge Scheduler, SSM parameter, IAM role, CloudWatch log group), and the deploy command shall fail before any change when the template declares another type.
The backend shall request only Yahoo's read scope.

The TV app shall run network requests and JSON parsing off the main thread, shall redraw only panel rows whose values changed, and shall stop panel requests while the panel is hidden; no document or submission text shall state a measured device latency, frame rate or memory figure.

The Alphazedehq repository shall contain one shared skill `skills/spec-authoring/` holding a `SKILL.md` within skill_size_max, a specification template, and build, lint and diagram scripts that run with `uv run --script` (PEP 723 inline dependencies) and Graphviz `dot`, without any project-specific Python environment, and shall retain the GridMarket MIT copyright and permission notice.

The spec-authoring skill’s operational text, templates and tool invocation shall contain no GridMarket product name, document id or `--project backend` flag; GridMarket references shall occur only in retained license, attribution and provenance records, and the skill shall contain no absolute local path; building and linting its shipped template in a temporary directory outside any git repository shall exit 0.

The spec-authoring skill description shall name SDoc and Requirements System documents as non-triggers and shall cite `requirements-engineering` by reference without restating its checklist, so that a request to author and build a Markdown specification selects spec-authoring and a request to publish an SDoc revision to the Requirements System selects `use-requirements-system`.

The skill's vendor step shall copy its scripts to `<repo>/tools/spec/` with a `VENDORED.md` naming the source repository, commit and MIT notice, and shall refuse to overwrite a vendored copy whose files differ from that recorded commit.

The program shall land the spec-authoring skill in Alphazedehq through its own pull request merged by rebase or merge commit, shall then link it into every harness skill directory that already links the shared skills, and shall have the D4 hook installer link it for the remaining harnesses of SD-021 or record each as a typed gap.

The repository shall have one gate entrypoint `tools/ci/gate.sh` with the areas `android`, `backend`, `spec` and `hygiene`; the local pre-commit and pre-push hooks and the Actions workflow shall invoke that entrypoint with the same area arguments, and each area shall exit non-zero when any of its checks fails.

The Actions workflow shall trigger on `pull_request` and `push` to `main` only (never `pull_request_target`), shall use a concurrency group per workflow and ref with cancel-in-progress, shall run an area only when its paths change, shall report one stable check name per area, shall pin every action to a full commit SHA, shall grant `contents: read` only, shall expose no secret to fork pull requests, and shall run on GitHub-hosted runners.

The `hygiene` area shall reject tracked files matching an absolute user-home path shape or the repository’s documented credential-detection rules for Yahoo client secrets, OAuth tokens, AWS credentials and device tokens, and shall identify each finding by file and rule identifier without printing the matched secret.

The repository shall contain the Vnv guidance tree: `docs/vnv/AGENTS.md` and one `docs/vnv/<area>/AGENTS.md` per area (tv-app, backend, device-integration, ci-cd, spec, developer-feedback), each naming Scope, Tools, Review Focus and findings target.

requirements.statement: The shared `setup-pre-commit` skill shall define one repo-agnostic gate entrypoint contract, shall ship a template gate script and an installer for local git hooks that invoke it, shall state that GitHub Actions invoke the same entrypoint, shall contain no `[TODO]` text, and its `SKILL.md` shall be within skill_size_max.

The shared `setup-a-repo` skill shall reference a workflow-authoring guide stating the rules of AC-AFC-CI-02 plus free hosted runners on public repositories and the gh_private_minutes budget (C11), and shall ship a checker script that exits non-zero on a workflow violating any of those rules; its `SKILL.md` shall be within skill_size_max.

The shared `ship-pull-request` skill shall run `vnv-review` when the repository has a Vnv guidance tree (`docs/vnv/AGENTS.md` or `Vnv/AGENTS.md`) and otherwise record REFUSED_NO_VNV, never a pass; its `references/GATES.md` shall gain a shared-gate row and an amazon-fantasy-companion row; its `SKILL.md` shall be within skill_size_max.

When AC-AFC-D4-01..03 are merged (C13), one shared hook script shall run the current repository's gate entrypoint before an agent-initiated `git commit` or `git push` in every harness named in SD-021 that exposes a pre-tool hook; the installer shall record each harness without one as a typed gap with its exact evidence, and shall expose the D4 skills in Muse's skill directory.
